analyst.sentenceEn: Flavoured water is booming: sales of the sparkling variety shot up by 20%, according to the latest analyst data.
analyst.translationZh: 风味水市场正在蓬勃发展：最新分析师数据显示，气泡型风味水销量飙升20%。

analyst.sentenceEn: Some analysts find age 45+ jobless workers are most likely to be unemployed for more than a year.
analyst.translationZh: 部分分析师发现，45岁以上的失业人员最有可能处于长达一年以上的失业状态。

anxious.sentenceEn: I just get anxious before I fly and feel nervous the whole time we're in the air, which is why I was hoping the television program would cover that topic more than it did.
anxious.translationZh: 我飞行前总会感到焦虑，而且在飞行过程中也一直很紧张，所以原本希望那个电视节目能对这个话题有更深入的探讨。
anxious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

anxious.sentenceEn: There are two different attachment styles: an anxious attachment style and an avoidant attachment style.
anxious.translationZh: 依恋类型主要有两种：焦虑型依恋和回避型依恋。
anxious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

anxious.sentenceEn: When there is a relationship breakdown with their parents, children with an anxious attachment style scream and cry to get their parents to come back.
anxious.translationZh: 当与父母的关系出现破裂时，具有焦虑型依恋风格的孩子会通过哭喊来试图让父母回到自己身边。
anxious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

anxious.sentenceEn: W: It's not entirely unusual to feel anxious or sad around your birthday.
anxious.translationZh: 在生日前后感到焦虑或难过也不完全是不正常的。
anxious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

anxious.sentenceEn: So the real danger here is that children who will be completely able to do math at a normal level may keep away from it because they feel anxious .
anxious.translationZh: 因此，真正的危险在于：那些完全有能力达到正常数学水平的孩子，可能会因为感到焦虑而对数学敬而远之。
anxious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

anxious.sentenceEn: How do children with an anxious attachment style react to a breakdown in their relationship with parents?
anxious.translationZh: 具有焦虑型依恋风格的儿童在与父母的关系破裂时会如何反应？

approval.sentenceEn: However, where we get into trouble is when our self-worth is dependent upon whether we win someone's approval or not.
approval.translationZh: 然而，当我们的自我价值取决于能否赢得他人认可时，问题就出现了。
approval.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

approval.sentenceEn: People-pleasing, or seeking self-worth through others' approval , is unproductive and an exhausting way to go through life.
approval.translationZh: 讨好他人，或者说通过他人的认可来寻求自我价值，是一种徒劳且令人疲惫的生活方式。
approval.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

approval.sentenceEn: As you become more capable of providing yourself with the approval you seek, your need for external validation will start to vanish, leaving you stronger, more confident, and yes, happier in your life.
approval.translationZh: 当你越来越能够给予自己所寻求的认可时，你对外部 validation 的需求就会开始消失，这会让你变得更强大、更自信，当然，也让你的生活更幸福。
approval.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

approval.sentenceEn: The service, which claims to be the first of its kind in India, offers only one route, but Bangalore airport will add more once it gets approval .
approval.translationZh: 这项号称印度首个此类服务目前仅提供一条航线，但班加罗尔机场在获得批准后将增加更多航线。
approval.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

approval.sentenceEn: What can we do when we become better able to provide ourselves with the desired approval ?
approval.translationZh: 当我们更有能力给予自己所需的认同时，我们能做些什么呢？

approval.sentenceEn: Get approval to add more routes.
approval.translationZh: 获得批准后将增加更多航线

assess.sentenceEn: Educational videos may deliver academic content, but they are unable to make eye contact or assess a student's level of engagement.
assess.translationZh: 教育视频或许能够传递学术内容，却无法与学生进行眼神交流，也无法评估学生的投入程度。
assess.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

assess.sentenceEn: We then assessed biological stress responses for students whose grades were dropping by examining their stress hormones(荷尔蒙).
assess.translationZh: 然后，我们通过检测学生的压力荷尔蒙来评估成绩下滑学生的生理压力反应。

assess.sentenceEn: Being humble means you have the ability to accurately assess your deficiencies without denying your skills and strengths.
assess.translationZh: 谦逊意味着你有能力准确评估自己的不足，同时又不否认自己的技能和优势。
assess.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

assess.sentenceEn: The trial assessed the effectiveness of an early mathematics intervention(干预) aimed at preschoolers.
assess.translationZh: 该试验评估了针对学龄前儿童开展早期数学干预的效果。

assess.sentenceEn: What should be prioritized in assessing employees' remote work?
assess.translationZh: 在评估员工远程工作时应优先考虑什么？

assess.sentenceEn: It caused damage too heavy to assess .
assess.translationZh: 此次坍塌造成的损害极为严重，目前无法评估。

assistance.sentenceEn: Adaptive cruise control is a driver assistance technology that sets a maximum speed for vehicles and automatically slows the speed of the car when traffic is sensed in front of the vehicle.
assistance.translationZh: 自适应巡航控制是一种驾驶员辅助技术，它为车辆设定最高速度，并在感应到前方有交通状况时自动降低车速。

assistance.sentenceEn: By contrast, only 29% thought supporting men and women age 18 to 24 is bad; the remaining 71% think that assistance "helps the adult children get ahead".
assistance.translationZh: 相比之下，只有29%的人认为支持18至24岁的年轻人是不好的；其余71%的人认为这种援助"有助于成年子女取得成功"。
assistance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

assistance.sentenceEn: But that represents a reduction from last year's energy assistance package of over $8 billion.
assistance.translationZh: 但这比去年超过80亿美元的能源援助方案有所减少。
assistance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

assistance.sentenceEn: Last month, the federal government added $1 billion in funding to Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program, bringing the total to $4.8 billion.
assistance.translationZh: 上个月，联邦政府为低收入家庭能源援助计划追加了10亿美元资金，使其总金额达到48亿美元。
assistance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

assistance.sentenceEn: According to a survey, while the majority believe too little assistance is given to the poor, more than a third believe too much is spent on welfare.
assistance.translationZh: 一项调查显示，虽然大多数人认为对穷人的援助太少，但超过三分之一的人认为在福利方面支出过多。

astronaut.sentenceEn: British astronaut Tim Peake is stepping down permanently from his role as a European astronaut .
astronaut.translationZh: 英国宇航员蒂姆·皮克将永久辞去欧洲宇航员职务。
astronaut.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

astronaut.sentenceEn: The former British Army Air Corps helicopter pilot was selected as a European Space Agency astronaut in 2009.
astronaut.translationZh: 这位前英国陆军航空兵团直升机飞行员于2009年被选为欧洲航天局宇航员。
astronaut.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

astronaut.sentenceEn: To prepare for eventually sending astronauts to Mars, NASA began taking applications Friday for four people to live for a year in Mars Dune Alpha.
astronaut.translationZh: 为最终实现将宇航员送上火星的目标，美国国家航空航天局（NASA）于周五开始招募四名志愿者，他们将在火星沙丘阿尔法（Mars Dune Alpha） habitat中生活一年。
astronaut.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

astronaut.sentenceEn: Attitude is key, said former Canadian astronaut Chris Hadfield.
astronaut.translationZh: 加拿大前宇航员克里斯·哈德菲尔德表示，态度是关键。
astronaut.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

astronaut.sentenceEn: The objects left by the Apollo astronauts included equipment that was no longer needed.
astronaut.translationZh: 阿波罗宇航员留下的物品包括那些不再需要的设备。
astronaut.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第10句

astronaut.translationZh: 他于2015年成为一名宇航员。

atmosphere.sentenceEn: When I think of motorsports in the U.S., what we all think of is Nascar, and the narrative of Nascar is sort of rural, white, working-class Americans, mostly in the South, connecting with the atmosphere of those races.
atmosphere.translationZh: 当我想到美国的赛车运动时，我们首先想到的都是纳斯卡车赛。纳斯卡车赛的故事叙事，在某种程度上代表着美国南部乡村地区的白人工人阶级，他们与这些赛事的氛围紧密相连。

atmosphere.sentenceEn: They favored a more rigid, closed-door, corporate atmosphere , while I would have preferred something more collaborative and open.
atmosphere.translationZh: 他们偏爱一种更为刻板、封闭的企业氛围，而我则更喜欢开放协作的工作环境。

atmosphere.sentenceEn: This can be a big indicator of what sort of atmosphere the company is trying to cultivate.
atmosphere.translationZh: 这能很好地表明公司想要营造什么样的氛围。

atmosphere.sentenceEn: The beans would then be roasted in the heat generated by the craft's 20-minute re-entry into Earth's atmosphere .
atmosphere.translationZh: 随后，咖啡豆将在航天器重返地球大气层的20分钟过程中所产生的热量中进行烘焙。
atmosphere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

atmosphere.sentenceEn: If savings are modest, then the many advantages of working in offices—such as lively atmosphere , rapidity of communication, team-building and acclimatization(适应环境) of new employees—will encourage employers to shelve the idea of remote work and, like Yahoo in 2013, encourage employees to work most of the time from corporate office space.
atmosphere.translationZh: 如果节省的成本有限，那么办公室办公的诸多优势——如活跃的氛围、高效的沟通、团队建设以及新员工的环境适应——将促使雇主搁置远程办公的想法，就像雅虎在2013年所做的那样，鼓励员工大部分时间在公司办公场所工作。
atmosphere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

atmosphere.sentenceEn: It will create a harmonious working atmosphere .
atmosphere.translationZh: 这将营造和谐的工作氛围。

accessible.sentenceEn: Apart from the urgent task of providing more healthy nutrients to those who increasingly can't afford them, publicly accessible fruit and vegetable gardens connect what we eat to where it comes from—the means of production, if you will.
accessible.translationZh: 除了向越来越多买不起健康食品的人提供更多健康营养这一紧迫任务外，公共果蔬园还将我们的食物与其来源——也就是生产方式（如果你愿意这么说的话）——联系起来。
accessible.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

accessible.sentenceEn: A better goal than building bigger houses for some is to create more publicly accessible spaces and amenities for all.
accessible.translationZh: 为一部分人建造更大的房子，不如为所有人创造更多可公开使用的空间和便利设施，这才是更理想的目标。
accessible.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

accessible.sentenceEn: W: Well, I suggest reorganizing your notes using color-coded sections in your study guides, or using idea mapping to lay out the information and make it more quickly accessible .
accessible.translationZh: 女：嗯，我建议你在学习指南中用不同颜色标记各个部分来重新整理笔记，或者用思维导图来呈现信息，这样能让你更快地获取所需内容。
accessible.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

accessible.sentenceEn: Those were the words uttered by pioneering British scientist Rosalind Franklin, who firmly believed that the pursuit of science should be accessible to all.
accessible.translationZh: 这是英国开创性科学家罗莎琳德·富兰克林的言论，她坚信科学探索应该是所有人都能接触的。
accessible.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

accessible.sentenceEn: What can publicly accessible fruit and vegetable gardens do apart from their practical functions?
accessible.translationZh: 除了实用功能外，公共果蔬园还能发挥什么作用？

accessible.sentenceEn: They are based on easily accessible material.
accessible.translationZh: 它们基于易于获取的材料。

actively.sentenceEn: You can start anywhere as long as you know your end goal and you commit to actively pursuing opportunities to learn and grow along the way.
actively.translationZh: 只要你明确最终目标，并致力于在过程中积极寻求学习和成长的机会，你可以从任何地方开始。
actively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句

actively.sentenceEn: Older workers who've actively engaged in more education and training relevant to their jobs turn this pretty much on its head.
actively.translationZh: 那些积极参与了更多与其工作相关的教育和培训的高龄员工，几乎彻底改观了这一局面。

actively.sentenceEn: Spend less time passively learning and more time actively practicing.
actively.translationZh: 少花时间被动学习，多花时间主动练习。

actively.sentenceEn: Here the words "deliberate" and "intention" are key, because they define the difference between actively practicing something and passively learning it.
actively.translationZh: 在这里，“刻意”和“意图”这两个词是关键，因为它们界定了主动练习与被动学习之间的区别。

actively.sentenceEn: Older workers who actively pursue more education and training have a good chance of being hired.
actively.translationZh: 积极追求深造和培训的高龄劳动者，被聘用的机会很大。

actively.sentenceEn: More and more women actively engaged in politics.
actively.translationZh: 越来越多的女性积极参与政治。

adulthood.sentenceEn: In fact, the respondents said, financial independence defines adulthood .
adulthood.translationZh: 事实上，受访者表示，经济独立是成年的标志。
adulthood.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

adulthood.sentenceEn: Although born gray, males of the species are easily identified as they enter adulthood by a decisive pink shade.
adulthood.translationZh: 该物种的雄性虽然出生时呈灰色，但进入成年期后会呈现出明显的粉红色调，因此很容易识别。
adulthood.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

adulthood.sentenceEn: Some aspects of our language abilities, such as our knowledge of word meanings, actually improve during middle and late adulthood .
adulthood.translationZh: 我们语言能力的某些方面，例如对词义的掌握，实际上在成年中后期会有所提升。
adulthood.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

adulthood.sentenceEn: Our eyesight may dim and our recall may weaken, but, by comparison, our ability to produce and to comprehend language is well preserved into older adulthood .
adulthood.translationZh: 我们的视力可能会衰退，记忆力可能会减弱，但相比之下，我们的语言生成和理解能力在老年时期仍然保持得很好。
adulthood.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

adulthood.sentenceEn: Giving young people the opportunity to become familiar with the world of money would provide them with a great advantage to enter adulthood with confidence and security so that they are able to manage their own money and look after themselves.
adulthood.translationZh: 让年轻人有机会熟悉金钱的世界，将为他们提供巨大优势，使他们能够充满信心和安全感地步入成年，从而能够管理自己的财务并照顾好自己。
adulthood.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

adulthood.sentenceEn: Allow them to enter adulthood with financial security.
adulthood.translationZh: 让他们带着经济保障步入成年。

adviser.sentenceEn: "It's very surprising to me," says Sam Chetan-Walsh, a political adviser at Greenpeace and campaigner against ocean plastic.
adviser.translationZh: 绿色和平组织政治顾问兼反海洋塑料活动家山姆·切坦-沃尔什表示：“这让我非常惊讶。”

adviser.sentenceEn: In the case of an attack, military advisers suggested the advantage of being able to operate one computer from another terminal.
adviser.translationZh: 军事顾问提出，若遇袭击，能够从另一终端操作计算机将是一大优势。
adviser.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

adviser.sentenceEn: In some departments, either the chairman or the director of graduate studies serves for at least the first semester as a new student adviser .
adviser.translationZh: 在一些院系，系主任或研究生部主任至少会在第一学期担任新生导师。
adviser.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

adviser.sentenceEn: If you're a graduate teaching assistant, your adviser also may be your boss.
adviser.translationZh: 如果你是研究生助教，你的导师也可能是你的上司。
adviser.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

adviser.sentenceEn: Later, students may have the opportunity of selecting the adviser that they prefer.
adviser.translationZh: 之后，学生可能有机会选择自己更喜欢的导师。
adviser.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

adviser.sentenceEn: How can new graduate students learn who their advisers are?
adviser.translationZh: 研究生新生如何了解自己的导师是谁？

ambition.sentenceEn: But an excess of ambition can also be dangerous, putting you at risk of burnout, stubbornness and even a shorter life.
ambition.translationZh: 但野心过大也可能带来危险，使你面临精疲力竭、固执己见甚至寿命缩短的风险。
ambition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

ambition.sentenceEn: Without any ambition , you wouldn't start your own business, set or achieve goals and get far in life.
ambition.translationZh: 没有任何抱负，你就不会开创自己的事业，不会设定或实现目标，也不会在人生中走得长远。
ambition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

ambition.sentenceEn: Most of us in the entrepreneurial community are blessed—or cursed—with higher-than-average ambition .
ambition.translationZh: 在创业圈中，我们大多数人都有幸——或者说不幸——拥有超乎常人的野心。
ambition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

ambition.sentenceEn: For people with limited ambition , however, failure is viewed as something closer to reality.
ambition.translationZh: 然而，对于野心有限的人来说，失败更像是现实的一部分。
ambition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

ambition.sentenceEn: What does the author advise us to do concerning ambition ?
ambition.translationZh: 关于雄心，作者建议我们做什么？

ambition.sentenceEn: Entrepreneurs' ambition does as much good as harm.
ambition.translationZh: 企业家的雄心壮志利弊相当。

apartment.sentenceEn: M: Hmm… I don't know if that's a good idea as your mother and I would worry about you living all by yourself in an apartment so far from home.
apartment.translationZh: 嗯……我不确定这是不是个好主意，因为你妈妈和我会担心你一个人住在离家这么远的公寓里。
apartment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

apartment.sentenceEn: Due to smoke and heat damage, the four apartments were declared uninhabitable, and the six residents had to move to another place, officials said.
apartment.translationZh: 官员表示，由于烟熏和热力损坏，这四套公寓已被宣布不适宜居住，六名居民不得不迁居他处。
apartment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

apartment.sentenceEn: Town records list four apartments in the building.
apartment.translationZh: 城镇记录显示该建筑内有四套公寓。
apartment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

apartment.sentenceEn: The police officer interviewed told news reporters the snake didn't belong to the man and it was unclear how it got into the apartment .
apartment.translationZh: 接受采访的警官告诉新闻记者，这条蛇不属于该男子，目前尚不清楚它是如何进入公寓的。
apartment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

apartment.sentenceEn: There are always several of those bikes out in front of our apartment complex.
apartment.translationZh: 我们公寓楼前面总是放着好几辆那种共享单车。
apartment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第2句

apartment.sentenceEn: They can only afford small apartments .
apartment.translationZh: 他们只能负担得起小公寓。

assumption.sentenceEn: Database technology enables business leaders to look to hard evidence in analyzing target markets and promotional strategies, rather than making assumptions or guesses on what works.
assumption.translationZh: 数据库技术使企业领导者能够依靠确凿证据来分析目标市场和促销策略，而非凭空臆断或猜测哪些方案有效。
assumption.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

assumption.sentenceEn: They had a tendency to reflect and question assumptions in the name of self-awareness and regularly took steps to adjust the things standing in their way to work-life balance.
assumption.translationZh: 他们倾向于以自我认知为名反思和质疑各种假设，并会定期采取措施调整那些阻碍他们实现工作与生活平衡的因素。

assumption.sentenceEn: As the scholar Silvia Federici put it in 1975, the unpaid nature of domestic work reinforces the assumption that "housework is not work, thus preventing women from struggling against it."
assumption.translationZh: 正如学者西尔维娅·费德里奇在1975年所指出的，家务劳动的无偿性质强化了'家务不是工作'这一观念，从而阻碍了女性对此进行抗争。

assumption.sentenceEn: And these assumptions give a false picture of reality.
assumption.translationZh: 而这些假设所呈现的现实图景是错误的。

assumption.sentenceEn: Assumptions about poor people become even more negative when they live on welfare.
assumption.translationZh: 当穷人依靠福利生活时，人们对他们的负面看法会变得更加严重。

attach.sentenceEn: However, an insecurely attached person won't.
attach.translationZh: 然而，依恋类型不安全的人则不会这样。
attach.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第4句

attach.sentenceEn: At around half past nine this morning, a trailer attached to a lorry turned over at the crossing of High Street in Milton.
attach.translationZh: 今天上午约九点半，一辆卡车载着的拖车在米尔顿高街路口发生侧翻。

accumulate.sentenceEn: In fact, scientists now suspect accumulating novel experiences, facts, and skills can keep people's minds more flexible.

accumulate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

accumulate.sentenceEn: One of my colleagues bought a lot of things on credit during her first year of work, and it became a bad habit, and she accumulated a lot of debt.

accumulate.sentenceEn: In the same way that learning a language or new skills takes time, building financial skills requires practice and years to gradually accumulate bits and pieces of knowledge.

accumulate.sentenceEn: After all, intelligent people earn more money, accumulate more wealth, and even live longer.
accumulate.translationZh: 毕竟，聪明人能赚更多钱，积累更多财富，甚至更长寿。

accumulate.sentenceEn: Bacteria accumulate because there isn't enough water in your mouth to wash it away, Sunshine can stop you from sweating, too.

accumulate.sentenceEn: The goal was to reach the top, accumulate wealth and retire to a life of ease.
accumulate.translationZh: 目标是晋升到高层，积累财富，然后退休享受安逸的生活。
accumulate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

adequate.sentenceEn: Physicians in the U.S. have never actually examined a patient with protein deficiency because simply by eating an adequate number of daily calories we are also most likely getting enough protein.

adequate.sentenceEn: This is partly because of adequate sunlight and partly because technology has become more affordable in the region.

adequate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

adequate.sentenceEn: But some experts worried that such public speculation might lead people to believe that disagreement about the details meant a lack of adequate scientific consensus over the safety and efficiency of modern-day medicine.

adequate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

adequate.sentenceEn: Adequate and timely IT support should also be available to enable users to cope with technological issues at work.
adequate.translationZh: 企业还应提供充分且及时的IT支持，以帮助用户应对工作中的技术问题。
adequate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

adequate.sentenceEn: One consequence of climate change is that some people may not have adequate access to certain foods.

appropriate.sentenceEn: It's gained through experience on the job and learning what's appropriate given the needs of the project.

appropriate.sentenceEn: According to the new rules, students of Taverham are required to wear smart black shoes appropriate for the workplace, Harris held that strengthened rules around school uniforms improved student outcomes and behavior.

appropriate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

appropriate.sentenceEn: Consider the fact that a 1918 catalog insisted that boys and girls be dressed in the appropriate color.

appropriate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

appropriate.sentenceEn: Mr Meteo takes the online weather forecast, converts it to a short recording in the appropriate language and makes it available on a basic phone.

appropriate.sentenceEn: The previous study found that nearly three-quarters of fathers saw two to four weeks as an appropriate duration for paternity leave and 76% said they would prefer not to take all their time off at once.

appropriate.sentenceEn: Learn to use appropriate body language first.
appropriate.translationZh: 首先要学会使用恰当的肢体语言。

approve.sentenceEn: We need to understand that when we desperately want someone to approve of us, it's being driven by that little kid part of us that is still terrified of abandonment.

approve.sentenceEn: I believe we have less connection with the value of our money when we just tap the " Approve " buttons on our phones.

architect.translationZh: 它们是根据建筑师的设计复制的。

arrangement.sentenceEn: What is the arrangement for that?
arrangement.translationZh: 关于这一点是如何安排的呢？
arrangement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第2句

arrangement.sentenceEn: Half of the women said they used flexible work arrangements after becoming a parent, while just 27% of men did.
arrangement.translationZh: 一半的女性表示成为父母后采用了弹性工作安排，而男性中这一比例仅为27%。

arrangement.sentenceEn: M: How do you like your new flexible working arrangement ?
arrangement.translationZh: 男：你觉得新的弹性工作安排怎么样？
arrangement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

arrangement.sentenceEn: Dating back to 1880, the most common living arrangement among young adults has been living with a romantic partner, whether a spouse or a significant other.
arrangement.translationZh: 追溯到1880年，年轻人最常见的居住方式是与恋人同住，无论是配偶还是重要伴侣。

arrangement.sentenceEn: This arrangement peaked around 1940, when about 35% of the nation's 18- to 34-year-olds lived with mom and/or dad (compared with 32% in 2014).
arrangement.translationZh: 这种居住方式在1940年左右达到顶峰，当时美国约35%的18至34岁年轻人与父母同住（相比之下，2014年这一比例为32%）。

arrangement.sentenceEn: Living with parents edges out other living arrangements for 18- to 34-year-olds
arrangement.translationZh: 与父母同住成为18至34岁年轻人最主要的居住方式

artistic.sentenceEn: The project is called Writing On It All, and it's a participatory writing project and artistic experiment that has happened on Governor's Island every summer since 2013.
artistic.translationZh: 这个项目名为“Writing On It All”（畅写墙），是一项参与式写作项目与艺术实验，自2013年起每年夏季都会在总督岛举办。
artistic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

artistic.sentenceEn: "Most of the participants are people who are just walking by or are on the island for other reasons, or they just kind of happen to be there," Alexandra Chasin, artistic director of Writing On It All, tells Smithsonian.com.
artistic.translationZh: "大多数参与者只是路过此地，或是因其他原因来到岛上，又或是恰巧出现在那里，""Writing On It All"项目的艺术总监亚历山德拉·蔡辛在接受《史密森尼》网站采访时表示。
artistic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

artistic.sentenceEn: Most recognizable of the ship designs are the ship's smoke stacks, but the fourth stack was actually just artistic in nature and served no functional purpose.
artistic.translationZh: 这些轮船设计中最引人注目的是它们的烟囱，但实际上第四个烟囱仅为装饰，并无实际功能。
artistic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

artistic.sentenceEn: Boys at single-sex schools were said to be more likely to get involved in cultural and artistic activities that helped develop their emotional expressiveness, rather than feeling they had to conform to the "boy code" of hiding their emotions to be a "real man".
artistic.translationZh: 据称，单性别学校的男孩更有可能参与有助于培养情感表达能力的文化和艺术活动，而不必去遵守那种为了成为“真正的男人”而隐藏情感的“男孩准则”。
artistic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

assist.sentenceEn: In 2019, the WFP assisted nearly 100 million people in 88 countries.
assist.translationZh: 2019年，世界粮食计划署（WFP）在88个国家援助了近1亿人。
assist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

assist.sentenceEn: In the initial results, assisted living residents did paint the most positive picture.
assist.translationZh: 在初步结果中，辅助生活机构的居住者描绘的情况确实最为积极。

assist.sentenceEn: In a multi-state study of assisted living, for instance, University of North Carolina researchers found that a host of variables—the facility's type, size or age; whether a chain owned it; how attractive the neighborhood was—had no significant relationship to how the residents fared in terms of illness, mental decline, hospitalizations or mortality.
assist.translationZh: 例如，在一项针对多个州辅助生活设施的研究中，北卡罗来纳大学的研究人员发现，许多变量——设施的类型、规模或年龄；是否为连锁经营；周边社区的吸引力——与居民在疾病、智力衰退、住院治疗或死亡率方面的状况并无显著关联。

assist.sentenceEn: Does assisted living really mark a great improvement over a nursing home, or has the industry simply hired better interior designers?
assist.translationZh: 辅助生活设施真的比养老院有了很大改善，还是这个行业只是雇了更好的室内设计师？

assist.sentenceEn: A friend recently took her mother to visit an expensive assisted living/nursing home near my town.
assist.translationZh: 最近，一位朋友带着她的母亲去参观了我镇附近一家收费昂贵的辅助生活/护理之家。

assist.sentenceEn: At first the researchers of the most recent study found residents in assisted living facilities gave higher scores on social interaction.
assist.translationZh: 最初，这项最新研究的研究人员发现，辅助生活设施的居民在社交互动方面得分更高。

attachment.sentenceEn: These include helping with social development, increasing physical activity, managing anxiety or serving as a source of attachment in the face of changing family structures.
attachment.translationZh: 这些包括帮助社会发展、增加体育活动、管理焦虑情绪，或在家庭结构变化的情况下作为情感依恋的来源。
attachment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

attachment.sentenceEn: This is intentional as the informal tone of the assistant helps create an emotional attachment .
attachment.translationZh: 这是有意为之的，因为语音助手的非正式语气有助于建立情感联系。

attachment.sentenceEn: It's related to their attachment styles.
attachment.translationZh: 这与他们的依恋类型有关。
attachment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

attachment.sentenceEn: And it's a very insecure attachment .
attachment.translationZh: 这确实是一种非常不安全的依恋类型。
attachment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第2句

attachment.sentenceEn: How do children with an anxious attachment style react to a breakdown in their relationship with parents?
attachment.translationZh: 具有焦虑型依恋风格的儿童在与父母的关系破裂时会如何反应？

attachment.sentenceEn: Kids and adults alike find in dogs a source of attachment .
attachment.translationZh: 无论孩子还是成人，都能在狗身上找到情感寄托。

automated.sentenceEn: They gathered together temperature readings collected by everything from a 19th century voyage of British naval ships to modern automated ocean probes.
automated.translationZh: 他们汇集了各种渠道收集的温度读数，来源从19世纪英国海军舰船的航行记录到现代自动化海洋探测器不等。
automated.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

automated.sentenceEn: Mark D. Shermis, a professor at the University of Akron in Ohio, supervised the Hewlett Foundation's contest on automated essay scoring and wrote a paper about the experiment.
automated.translationZh: 俄亥俄州阿克伦大学教授马克·D·舍米斯(Mark D. Shermis)负责监督了休利特基金会举办的自动作文评分竞赛，并撰写了一篇关于该实验的论文。

automated.sentenceEn: On Tuesday, Stanford announced that it would work with EdX to develop a joint educational system that will make use of the automated assessment technology.
automated.translationZh: 周二，斯坦福大学宣布将与EdX合作开发一个联合教育系统，该系统将利用自动化评分技术。

automated.sentenceEn: But skeptics(怀疑者) argue the automated system is no match for live teachers.
automated.translationZh: 但怀疑者认为，自动化系统无法与真人教师相媲美。

automated.sentenceEn: EdX, the nonprofit enterprise founded by Harvard and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) to offer courses on the Internet, has just introduced such a system and will make its automated (自动的) software available free on the Web to any institution that wants to use it.
automated.translationZh: edX是由哈佛大学和麻省理工学院联合创办的非营利性企业，旨在提供网络课程。该机构刚刚推出了这样一个系统，并将把其自动评分软件在网络上免费提供给任何想要使用的机构。

automated.sentenceEn: Some professionals in education are collecting signatures to voice their opposition to automated essay grading.
automated.translationZh: 一些教育界专业人士正在征集签名，以表达他们对自动化论文评分的反对意见。

alike.sentenceEn: Authors, artists and children alike have dreamed of such a gift from the sea.
alike.translationZh: 作家、艺术家和孩子们都曾梦想过这样一份来自大海的礼物。
alike.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

alike.sentenceEn: Now it seems their brains are alike , too.
alike.translationZh: 如今看来，他们的大脑也存在相似之处。
alike.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

alike.sentenceEn: Big, systematic data is mostly the foundation of most of our decisions, personal and business alike .
alike.translationZh: 大量系统化的数据基本上是我们大多数决策的基础，无论是个人决策还是商业决策。
alike.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

alike.sentenceEn: Learning and practicing seem to be very much alike , but the two processes can lead to quite different outcomes.
alike.translationZh: 学习和练习看似非常相似，但这两个过程却可能导致截然不同的结果。

alike.sentenceEn: It is a sign of dreaming in adults and infants alike .
alike.translationZh: 它是成年人和婴儿正在做梦的标志。

ancestor.sentenceEn: She says her ancestors were from Britain.
ancestor.translationZh: 她说她的祖先是英国人。
ancestor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

ancestor.sentenceEn: Proto-Indo-European was decimally oriented because, as in so many cultures, our ancestors' hands served as the gateway to the realization that "five fingers on one hand is the same as five fingers on the other."
ancestor.translationZh: 原始印欧语之所以采用十进制，是因为正如在许多文化中那样，我们的祖先通过双手认识到'一只手上的五根手指与另一只手上的五根手指数量相同'。

ancestor.sentenceEn: Well, if I could go back in history and live, I'd like to go back to the 18th century and perhaps in colonial America in Yankee New England where one of my ancestors lived, because it was the beginning of something.
ancestor.translationZh: 嗯，如果我能回到过去生活，我想回到18世纪，或许是在殖民时期的美洲，我一位祖先曾居住的新英格兰扬基地区，因为那是某种事物的开端。
ancestor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

ancestor.sentenceEn: My ancestor was a preacher traveling around the countryside.
ancestor.translationZh: 我的祖先是一位在乡村巡回布道的牧师。
ancestor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

ancestor.sentenceEn: Modern techniques for producing and shipping food led to greater variety and quantity, including a tremendous increase in the amount of animal protein and dairy products available, making us more vigorous than our ancestors .
ancestor.translationZh: 现代化的食品生产和运输技术带来了食物种类的增多和数量的增加，其中动物蛋白和乳制品的供应量大幅提升，这使我们比祖先更加精力充沛。
ancestor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

arise.sentenceEn: Researchers have suggested that such links could arise from various things.
arise.translationZh: 研究人员认为，这种关联可能源于多种因素。
arise.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

arise.sentenceEn: In light of Hershfield's study, one simple question arises : Is it possible to make our present selves give a damn about our future selves?
arise.translationZh: 根据赫什菲尔德的研究，一个简单的问题浮出水面：我们是否有可能让现在的自己真正关心未来的自己？

arise.sentenceEn: How did these personal bubbles arise ?
arise.translationZh: 这些个人空间气泡是如何形成的？
arise.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

arise.translationZh: 关于莎士比亚，流传着许多传说。
arise.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第11句

arise.sentenceEn: According to a magazine writer, some small business owners' resistance to bike lanes arises from cultural factors.
arise.translationZh: 一位杂志撰稿人表示，一些小企业主对自行车道的抵触情绪源于文化因素。

arise.sentenceEn: A lot of controversy will arise .
arise.translationZh: 此举将会引发诸多争议。

acceptable.translationZh: 我认为这两种情况都不可接受。
acceptable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

acceptable.sentenceEn: Only American citizens or permanent U.S. residents are acceptable .
acceptable.translationZh: 仅限美国公民或美国永久居民可申请。
acceptable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

acceptable.sentenceEn: It is neither desirable nor morally acceptable nor practical for this county to tolerate the signs of deprivation more commonly associated with the slums(贫民窟) of Rio de Janiero.
acceptable.translationZh: 对于洛杉矶县而言，容忍此类通常与里约热内卢贫民窟相关的贫困景象，既不可取，也有悖道德，更不切实际。
acceptable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

acceptable.sentenceEn: "We did a study on paternity leave five years ago. Compared with those findings, these numbers were shocking to me. I did not expect 80% of people to say the organisation finds dads taking this leave acceptable and three-quarters to say it's equally supportive of women and men taking leave," Harrington said.
acceptable.translationZh: 哈林顿表示：“我们五年前曾做过一项关于陪产假的研究。与当时的结果相比，这次的数据令我震惊。我没想到会有80%的受访者认为公司接受父亲休陪产假，也没想到会有四分之三的人认为公司对男女休育儿假一视同仁。”

acceptable.sentenceEn: Research by the Boston College Center for Work & Family, which surveyed new parents at four large US companies who were qualified for taking at least six weeks paid parental leave, found that 81% of the 1,240 employees surveyed said the notion of fathers taking leave has become more acceptable .
acceptable.translationZh: 波士顿学院工作与家庭中心对美国四家大型公司中符合至少六周带薪育儿假条件的新手父母进行了调查。该研究发现，在1240名受访员工中，81%的人表示父亲休育儿假的观念已变得更易被接受。

acceptable.sentenceEn: It is becoming more acceptable to many who used to think it offensive.
acceptable.translationZh: 对于许多过去认为这是冒犯行为的人来说，这正变得越来越可以接受。

addiction.sentenceEn: Newspapers are constantly filled with frightening accounts of drug addiction and aggressive behaviour supposedly caused by violent video games.
addiction.translationZh: 报纸上总是充斥着令人心惊的报道，称暴力电子游戏据称会导致青少年吸毒成瘾和攻击性行为。

addiction.sentenceEn: And now, the World Health Organization has recognized addiction to computer games as a disease.
addiction.translationZh: 如今，世界卫生组织已将电脑游戏成瘾认定为一种疾病。
addiction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

addiction.sentenceEn: Thus, they claim it is too early to call computer game addiction a disorder.
addiction.translationZh: 因此，他们认为将电脑游戏成瘾称为一种疾病还为时过早。
addiction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第8句

addiction.sentenceEn: To meet the new definition for addiction , the behavior must damage a person's relationships or performance at school or work, and this must last for at least a year.
addiction.translationZh: 根据新的成瘾定义，该行为必须对个人的人际关系或学业/工作表现造成损害，且这种情况必须持续至少一年。
addiction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

addiction.sentenceEn: What do some behavior experts think of addiction to computer games?
addiction.translationZh: 一些行为专家如何看待电脑游戏成瘾？

addiction.sentenceEn: Addiction to computer games is a disease.
addiction.translationZh: 电脑游戏成瘾是一种疾病。

adventure.sentenceEn: The desire for adventure is a human one.
adventure.translationZh: 对冒险的渴望是人类共有的天性。
adventure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

adventure.sentenceEn: One author has mentioned that women desire to play an irreplaceable role in a great adventure .
adventure.translationZh: 一位作家曾指出，女性渴望在一场伟大的冒险中扮演不可替代的角色。
adventure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

adventure.sentenceEn: Now known as "New York's shared space for art and play," the island, which lies between Manhattan and Brooklyn in Upper New York Bay, is closed to cars but open to summer tourists who flock for festivals, picnics, adventures , as well as these "legal graffiti(涂鸦)" sessions.
adventure.translationZh: 如今，这座位于上纽约湾、地处曼哈顿与布鲁克林之间的岛屿被誉为"纽约艺术与休闲共享空间"。该岛禁止机动车通行，但对夏季游客开放，他们纷纷前来参加节庆活动、野餐、探险，以及这些"合法涂鸦"活动。
adventure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

adventure.sentenceEn: Drawing in adventure seekers and experienced divers, this new artificial Airbus reef will be a scuba diver's paradise(天堂).
adventure.translationZh: 这处全新的空客人工鱼礁将吸引众多探险爱好者和经验丰富的潜水员，成为水肺潜水者的天堂。
adventure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

adventure.sentenceEn: Taking a trip underwater and exploring the inside of a sunken A300 would be quite an adventure , and that is exactly what Turkish authorities are hoping this attraction will make people think.
adventure.translationZh: 潜入水下探索这架沉没的A300客机内部绝对是一场非凡的冒险，而这正是土耳其当局希望这一景点能给人们带来的感受。
adventure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

advertising.sentenceEn: Advertising campaigns from the snack food companies, often featuring sports stars, send the message that we can neutralize any negative effects of consuming their products simply by getting more physical exercise.
advertising.translationZh: 零食公司的广告活动通常由体育明星代言，传达出这样一种信息：只要增加体育锻炼，我们就能抵消食用其产品所带来的负面影响。
advertising.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

advertising.sentenceEn: The article also explained how advertising campaigns specifically target very young and poor people, causing harm for these vulnerable groups.
advertising.translationZh: 文章还解释了广告活动是如何专门针对青少年和贫困群体的，而这正在对这些弱势群体造成伤害。
advertising.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

advertising.sentenceEn: They worry assistants will one day be used to deliver advertising directly to us.
advertising.translationZh: 他们担心有朝一日语音助手会被用来直接向我们推送广告。

advertising.sentenceEn: Fraudsters also invest in pay-per-click advertising to feature at the top of search engines when people type in phrases such as "Spanish seaside villas".
advertising.translationZh: 诈骗者还投资于付费点击广告，以便在人们输入诸如“西班牙海滨别墅”等搜索词时，能出现在搜索引擎结果的顶部。

advertising.sentenceEn: What do we learn about advertising campaigns from the snack food companies?
advertising.translationZh: 关于零食公司的广告活动，我们能了解到什么？

advertising.sentenceEn: A totally different approach could be adopted to combat advertising campaigns for snack food.
advertising.translationZh: 可以采取一种完全不同的方法来应对零食广告攻势。

aisle.sentenceEn: Regular shoppers at the supermarket are familiar with the sight of several cats settling down in the shop aisles .
aisle.translationZh: 这家超市的常客们对几只猫咪在商店过道里安顿下来的景象已经习以为常。
aisle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

aisle.sentenceEn: The revolutionary idea of a self-service grocery, where people could hunt and gather food from aisles rather than asking a clerk to fetch items from behind a counter, first came about in America.
aisle.translationZh: 自助杂货店这一革命性理念最早出现在美国——在这里，人们可以从货架通道自行挑选食物，而无需让店员从柜台后取货。
aisle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

aisle.sentenceEn: The book The Hidden Persuaders, published in 1957, warned that supermarkets were putting women in a "hypnoidal trance(催眠恍惚状态)," causing them to wander aisles bumping into boxes and "picking things off shelves at random."
aisle.translationZh: 1957年出版的《隐性说服者》一书警告称，超市正让女性陷入一种“催眠恍惚状态”，使她们在过道里漫无目的地游荡，撞到货架上的箱子，并“随意从货架上挑选商品”。
aisle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

aisle.sentenceEn: There are no formulas written on the insides of hands or students looking across the aisle , or whispering answers to their classmates.
aisle.translationZh: 如今，学生们不再在手心写公式，不再隔着过道张望，也不再低声向同学传递答案。
aisle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

aisle.sentenceEn: By Saturday morning, all the cans and jars in my aisle were replaced with the labels facing smartly out, like a line of soldiers on review.
aisle.translationZh: 到周六早上，我负责的货架通道里，所有罐头和瓶子都已重新摆放整齐，标签醒目地朝外，如同接受检阅的士兵队列。
aisle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第21句

anumeric.sentenceEn: Speakers of anumeric , or numberless, languages offer a window into how the invention of numbers reshaped the human experience.
anumeric.translationZh: 使用无数字语言（或称没有数字词汇的语言）的人，为我们提供了一扇窗口，让我们了解数字的发明如何重塑了人类的体验。

anumeric.sentenceEn: As a child, I spent some time living with anumeric people, the Piraha who live along the banks of the black Maici River.
anumeric.translationZh: 小时候，我曾与无数字语言族群——皮拉哈人共同生活过一段时间，他们居住在黑色的迈西河沿岸。

anumeric.sentenceEn: Responses suggest that anumeric people have some trouble keeping track of how many nuts remain in the can, even if there are only four or five in total.
anumeric.translationZh: 实验结果表明，即使罐子里总共只有四五个坚果，无数字语言者也难以准确记住罐中剩余坚果的数量。

anumeric.sentenceEn: This conclusion is echoed by work with anumeric children in industrialized societies.
anumeric.translationZh: 这一结论在对工业化社会中无数字概念儿童的研究中得到了印证。

anumeric.sentenceEn: It is worth stressing that these anumeric people are cognitively(在认知方面) normal, well-adapted to the surroundings they have dominated for centuries.
anumeric.translationZh: 值得强调的是，这些无数字语言使用者在认知方面完全正常，并且已经很好地适应了他们主宰了数世纪的环境。

anumeric.sentenceEn: It is difficult for anumeric people to keep track of the change in numbers even when the total is very small.
anumeric.translationZh: 无数字语言者很难追踪数量的变化，即使总数非常小。

apologize.sentenceEn: A Japanese mayor apologized Thursday for biting the Olympic gold medal of a softball player.
apologize.translationZh: 一名日本市长周四就咬一位垒球运动员的奥运金牌一事道歉。
apologize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

apologize.sentenceEn: Dorchester County officials apologized for the accidental mass killing of bees.
apologize.translationZh: 多切斯特县官员对此次意外大规模杀死蜜蜂事件表示道歉。
apologize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

apologize.sentenceEn: "So when I apologize , I usually choose in-person first, or a phone conversation as my top alternative, and maybe a handwritten note next. Apologizing by email is something I now totally avoid"
apologize.translationZh: 所以在道歉时，我通常首选当面沟通，或者退而求其次选择电话交谈，也可能再考虑手写便条。通过电子邮件道歉是我现在完全避免的做法。
apologize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

apologize.sentenceEn: Have you ever used email to apologize to a colleague?
apologize.translationZh: 你是否曾经用电子邮件向同事道歉？
apologize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

apologize.sentenceEn: He apologized for scratching an athlete's gold medal.
apologize.translationZh: 他为咬坏一名运动员的金牌而道歉。

apparent.sentenceEn: These are generally known as "phantom" traffic jams, in which dense traffic crawls to a halt for no apparent reason at all.
apparent.translationZh: 这些通常被称为“幽灵”交通拥堵，即密集的车流毫无明显原因地缓慢停滞。

apparent.sentenceEn: This characteristic is particularly apparent in a new study, focusing on people who underwent a hemispherectomy, a surgical procedure in which half of the brain is removed to treat illness.
apparent.translationZh: 这一特征在一项新研究中尤为明显，该研究关注接受了半球切除术的人群——这是一种通过切除大脑半球来治疗疾病的外科手术。
apparent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

apparent.sentenceEn: It wasn't apparent at the time, but Red Rum had a serious bone disease in his foot.
apparent.translationZh: 当时，这一点并不明显，但雷德罗姆的脚部患有严重的骨病。
apparent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

apparent.sentenceEn: These invisible duties become apparent only when you don't do them.
apparent.translationZh: 这些隐形的职责只有在你不去做的时候才会显现出来。

apparent.sentenceEn: The first type is apparent in people being stressed about the normal ups and downs of investment markets—actually not so much the ups, but definitely the downs.
apparent.translationZh: 第一种类型表现为人们对投资市场正常的起伏感到焦虑——实际上，他们对上涨不怎么在意，但对下跌却反应强烈。
apparent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

apparent.sentenceEn: Their stress was more apparent than real.
apparent.translationZh: 他们的压力更多是表面现象而非真实存在。

apparently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

apparently.sentenceEn: Apparently associating a healthy diet with teenagers' own values seems to be a promising avenue to prevent obesity.
apparently.translationZh: 显然，将健康饮食与青少年自身的价值观联系起来，似乎是预防肥胖的一条有效途径。
apparently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第6句

apparently.sentenceEn: Apparently , if you're more naturally driven to set goals, you are more likely to succeed.
apparently.translationZh: 显然，如果你天生更有设定目标的动力，你就更有可能成功。
apparently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

apparently.sentenceEn: He said the new finding is apparently reasonable and worth some attention.
apparently.translationZh: 他表示这项新发现显然是合理的，值得关注。

apparently.sentenceEn: It fell through the wooden floorboards, apparently lost forever.
apparently.translationZh: 戒指从木地板的缝隙中掉落，显然已经永远遗失了。
apparently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

apparently.sentenceEn: The author thinks her friend made a rational decision in choosing a more hospitable place over an apparently elegant assisted living home.
apparently.translationZh: 作者认为，她的朋友做出了一个理性的决定——选择一个更热情友好的地方，而非表面上高雅的辅助生活之家。

arouse.sentenceEn: Most stores open with flowers, fruit and vegetables at the front as a breath of freshness to arouse our appetite.
arouse.translationZh: 大多数超市一进门的区域摆放着鲜花、水果和蔬菜，以一股清新气息勾起顾客的食欲。
arouse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

arouse.sentenceEn: Recent open debates on scientific research, health, and policy have aroused greater public attention and encouraged more diverse voices.
arouse.translationZh: 最近关于科学研究、健康和政策的公开辩论引起了公众更多的关注，并鼓励了更多元化的声音参与其中。
arouse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

arouse.sentenceEn: Prices are kept within reasonable ranges to avoid arousing suspicion.
arouse.translationZh: 房价被控制在合理范围内，以避免引起怀疑。

arouse.sentenceEn: If you don't arouse someone's curiosity or brighten someone's day, you probably come across as being a little bit dull.
arouse.translationZh: 如果你无法激起他人的好奇心，也不能给别人的生活带来一丝光彩，那你给人的印象可能就会有些沉闷无趣。

arouse.sentenceEn: Why did a recent debate published in The New York Times arouse concerns among experts?
arouse.translationZh: 《纽约时报》近期发表的一场辩论为何引起了专家们的担忧？

arouse.sentenceEn: Arouse customers' appetite to buy flowers, fruit and vegetables.
arouse.translationZh: 激发顾客购买鲜花、水果和蔬菜的食欲

arrange.sentenceEn: Whatever you're reviewing, it's important that it's arranged for your particular needs of that subject, and in the most user-friendly way you can.
arrange.translationZh: 无论你复习什么内容，重要的是要根据该学科的特定需求来组织材料，并且要尽可能以方便自己使用的方式来整理。
arrange.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

arrange.sentenceEn: M: So you think I should arrange my notes using color and pictures in place of text.
arrange.translationZh: 男：所以你觉得我应该用颜色和图片来整理笔记，而不是文字。
arrange.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

arrange.sentenceEn: "And an error occurred during the connections in Denver. We have notified our customers that their pets arrived safely. We will arrange to return the pets to them as soon as possible," a spokesperson of United Airlines said.
arrange.translationZh: 美国联合航空公司的一位发言人表示：“在丹佛转机过程中出现了失误。我们已通知客户他们的宠物已安全抵达。我们将尽快安排将宠物送还给他们。”
arrange.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

arrange.sentenceEn: And my university classmates are arranging a trip to visit our old campus, and I'd love to go with them.
arrange.translationZh: 而且我的大学同学正在安排回母校的旅行，我很想和他们一起去。
arrange.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第5句

arrange.sentenceEn: She primarily speaks to students in health classes, but sometimes the school will arrange for her to speak to several different groups of girls.
arrange.translationZh: 她主要在健康课上给学生们演讲，但有时学校也会安排她给不同的女生团体做演讲。
arrange.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

arrange.sentenceEn: Arrange them using color and pictures.
arrange.translationZh: 用颜色和图片来整理它们

asset.sentenceEn: Saying "no" is an important skill to develop at any stage of your career because it retains the most important asset in life: your time.
asset.translationZh: 在职业生涯的任何阶段，学会说"不"都是一项重要技能，因为它能帮你保留人生中最重要的资产：你的时间。

asset.sentenceEn: Perhaps it is not surprising, then, that humility appears to be a huge asset to relationships.
asset.translationZh: 那么，谦逊似乎是人际关系中的一大宝贵财富，这或许就不足为奇了。
asset.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

asset.sentenceEn: Just lengthening that second stage of full-time work may secure the financial assets needed for a 100-year life, but such persistent work will inevitably exhaust precious intangible assets such as productive skills, vitality, happiness, and friendship.
asset.translationZh: 仅仅延长全职工作的第二阶段或许能积累百年人生所需的财务资产，但这种持续不断的工作将不可避免地耗尽宝贵的无形资产，如生产技能、活力、幸福感和友谊。

asset.sentenceEn: In a 2011 USPS case study, the agency emphasized its massive infrastructure as a "unique federal asset " to be called upon in a disaster or terrorist attack.
asset.translationZh: 在2011年美国邮政署的一份案例研究中，该机构强调其庞大的基础设施是在灾难或恐怖袭击发生时可调用的'独特联邦资产'。

asset.sentenceEn: The Competition Commission is now to investigate whether the British Airports Authority needs to sell off some of its assets .
asset.translationZh: 竞争委员会目前将调查英国机场管理局是否需要出售其部分资产。
asset.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

asset.translationZh: 将我们的经历视为宝贵资产。

automatically.sentenceEn: Adaptive cruise control is a driver assistance technology that sets a maximum speed for vehicles and automatically slows the speed of the car when traffic is sensed in front of the vehicle.
automatically.translationZh: 自适应巡航控制是一种驾驶员辅助技术，它为车辆设定最高速度，并在感应到前方有交通状况时自动降低车速。

automatically.sentenceEn: Almost half of our daily actions are part of our habits and not decisions, so once the correct habits are in place, you will automatically perform those tasks on a day-to-day basis.
automatically.translationZh: 我们日常近半数的行为都源于习惯而非刻意决定，因此一旦养成了正确的习惯，你就会自然而然地在日常生活中践行这些行为。
automatically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

automatically.sentenceEn: Now they can dictate notes on a patient's health condition and treatment and a smart assistant automatically enters the information into the right fields on a web form.
automatically.translationZh: 现在，他们可以口述关于患者健康状况和治疗方案的记录，智能助手会自动将信息填入网页表单的相应字段中。

automatically.sentenceEn: People automatically assume children are anxious about math because they are poor achievers.
automatically.translationZh: 人们想当然地认为，孩子们之所以对数学感到焦虑，是因为他们成绩不好。
automatically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

automatically.sentenceEn: What will help people stick to doing something constructive automatically ?
automatically.translationZh: 什么能帮助人们自动坚持做有建设性的事情？

automatically.sentenceEn: They will automatically be given hiring priority.
automatically.translationZh: 你会自动获得优先录用权。

accurately.sentenceEn: Being humble means you have the ability to accurately assess your deficiencies without denying your skills and strengths.
accurately.translationZh: 谦逊意味着你有能力准确评估自己的不足，同时又不否认自己的技能和优势。
accurately.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

accurately.sentenceEn: NASA used the term "climate change" because it more accurately reflects the wide range of changes to the planet caused by increasing amounts of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere.
accurately.translationZh: 美国国家航空航天局（NASA）使用“气候变化”这一术语，是因为它更准确地反映了大气中温室气体含量增加给地球带来的一系列广泛变化。
accurately.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

accurately.sentenceEn: Scientists shaped the history of the terms while attempting to accurately describe how humans continue to alter the planet.
accurately.translationZh: 科学家们在试图准确描述人类如何持续改变地球的过程中，塑造了这些术语的历史。
accurately.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

accurately.sentenceEn: Researchers have found that students who sign up to tutor others work harder to understand the material, recall it more accurately and apply it more effectively.
accurately.translationZh: 研究人员发现，那些主动报名辅导他人的学生，会更努力地去理解学习材料，更准确地记忆内容，并且更有效地运用所学知识。
accurately.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

accurately.sentenceEn: Who tended to rate their diet more accurately in the survey?
accurately.translationZh: 在调查中，哪些人倾向于更准确地评价自己的饮食？

accurately.sentenceEn: People's calorie intake was far from accurately reported.
accurately.translationZh: 人们的卡路里摄入量远未得到准确报告。

acquaintance.sentenceEn: Here people feel comfortable conducting routine social interactions with new acquaintances or total strangers.
acquaintance.translationZh: 在这个距离内，人们与新认识的人或完全陌生的人进行日常社交互动时会感到自在。
acquaintance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

acquaintance.sentenceEn: A mere acquaintance entering our intimate space makes us uncomfortable.
acquaintance.translationZh: 仅仅是一个泛泛之交进入我们的私密空间就会让我们感到不适。
acquaintance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

acquaintance.sentenceEn: Friends and acquaintances can comfortably occupy this zone, especially during informal conversations, but strangers are forbidden.
acquaintance.translationZh: 朋友和熟人可以自在地处于这个空间内，尤其是在非正式交谈时，但陌生人则不被允许。
acquaintance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

acquaintance.sentenceEn: One common French custom of greetings is cheek-kissing, but it is mostly restricted to friends, close acquaintances and family members.
acquaintance.translationZh: 法国一种常见的问候习俗是亲吻脸颊，但这主要限于朋友、亲密熟人和家庭成员之间。
acquaintance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

acquaintance.sentenceEn: Where do people feel comfortable interacting with new acquaintances or strangers?
acquaintance.translationZh: 人们在何处与新认识的人或陌生人交流时会感到舒适？

acquaintance.sentenceEn: It renders the acquaintance a stranger.
acquaintance.translationZh: 这会让熟人变得形同陌路。

adjustment.sentenceEn: In essence, each driver would constantly make adjustments to keep their car roughly halfway between the car in front and the car behind.
adjustment.translationZh: 本质上，每位司机都需要不断调整，使自己的车大致保持在前方车辆和后方车辆之间的中间位置。

adjustment.sentenceEn: Instead, they suggest it may be more of a lifelong process—a continuous, never-ending exercise that requires self-awareness and timely adjustments .
adjustment.translationZh: 相反，他们认为这更可能是一个终身过程——一种持续不断、永无止境的实践，需要自我认知和适时调整。

adjustment.sentenceEn: They also need to recognise that men have to make significant adjustments when they become parents.
adjustment.translationZh: 他们还需要认识到，男性在成为父亲后也必须做出重大调整。

adjustment.sentenceEn: The nutritional and health crises that followed the policy of structural adjustment , he says, led to many children and teenagers failing to reach their full potential in terms of height.
adjustment.translationZh: 他表示，结构调整政策引发的营养与健康危机，导致许多儿童和青少年无法充分发挥其身高潜力。
adjustment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

adjustment.sentenceEn: After some adjustments , and sufficient time, Jill was able to answer the students' questions correctly 97% of the time.
adjustment.translationZh: 经过一些调整和足够的时间训练后，吉尔能够以97%的准确率正确回答学生的问题。
adjustment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

adjustment.sentenceEn: According to Horn, drivers making constant adjustments for equal spacing between cars in a flow of traffic can help reduce phantom traffic jams.
adjustment.translationZh: 霍恩认为，驾驶员在车流中不断调整以保持车辆间等距，可以帮助减少幽灵交通拥堵。

administrative.sentenceEn: Probably more than half of all administrative work is only there because of an ever-existing sense that "you can't trust anyone these days."
administrative.translationZh: 或许半数以上的行政工作之所以存在，都源于一种根深蒂固的观念："如今你不能相信任何人。"
administrative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

administrative.sentenceEn: Every new problem creates a new job for an administrative fixer.
administrative.translationZh: 每出现一个新问题，就会催生一个新的行政解决岗位。
administrative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

administrative.sentenceEn: If we replaced half of our administrative staff with classroom teachers, we might actually get a majority of our classes back to 20 or fewer students per teacher.
administrative.translationZh: 如果我们将一半的行政人员换成任课教师，实际上我们大多数班级的师生比可能会回到每位教师教20名或更少学生的状态。
administrative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

administrative.sentenceEn: It's an administrative sham(欺诈) of the kind that has multiplied over the last 30 years.
administrative.translationZh: 这是一种行政欺诈行为，而这类行径在过去30年间不断增多。
administrative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

administrative.sentenceEn: Then I went into local government because I found I was more interested in the administrative side, then I progressed on to universities.
administrative.translationZh: 后来我进入了地方政府工作，因为我发现自己对行政管理方面更感兴趣，之后又转到了大学工作。
administrative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

administrative.sentenceEn: They may lose faith in their administrative abilities.
administrative.translationZh: 他们可能会对自己的管理能力失去信心。

administrator.sentenceEn: Project-based learning has grown in popularity with teachers and administrators .
administrator.translationZh: 项目式学习越来越受到教师和管理人员的欢迎。

administrator.sentenceEn: A good rule of thumb is that as soon as generals and hospital administrators jump on a management bandwagon, it is time to ask questions.
administrator.translationZh: 一个很好的经验法则是：一旦将军和医院管理者都跟风采用某种管理方式，就应该开始质疑了。

administrator.sentenceEn: With standardized test scores in the U.S. dropping in recent years, some administrators believe students need to spend more time in the classroom instead of on the playground.
administrator.translationZh: 近年来美国标准化考试成绩下滑，一些管理人员认为学生需要更多时间待在教室里，而不是在操场上。
administrator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

administrator.sentenceEn: Of course, sons and daughters want to visit the facilities, talk to the administrators and residents and other families, and do everything possible to fulfill their duties.
administrator.translationZh: 当然，子女们都想去参观这些养老机构，与管理人员、入住老人以及其他家庭交流，并尽一切可能履行自己的责任。

administrator.sentenceEn: I think most of the administrators I've come across have degrees in all sorts of things.
administrator.translationZh: 我觉得我遇到的大多数行政管理人员都拥有各种各样的学位。
administrator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

administrator.sentenceEn: Administrators seem to believe that only hard work will lead children to their educational goals.
administrator.translationZh: 管理者似乎认为只有努力学习才能引导孩子们实现他们的教育目标。

advancement.sentenceEn: Most people set goals to achieve delayed, long-term benefits, such as career advancement , debt repayment, or improved health.
advancement.translationZh: 大多数人设定目标是为了获得延迟的长期利益，例如职业发展、偿还债务或改善健康。

advancement.sentenceEn: On the subject of career advancement , 59% of women and 49% of men said leave could be limiting and both genders said they feared it would have an impact on their progress long-term.
advancement.translationZh: 在职业发展方面，59%的女性和49%的男性表示休产假/陪产假可能会限制职业发展，且男女都担心这会对他们的长期职业进步产生影响。

advancement.sentenceEn: Companies cannot do all these things to enhance women's advancement and then turn around and say, 'Oh, but we don't expect the men to take over for the women at home.'
advancement.translationZh: 公司不能一边做着所有这些促进女性职业发展的事情，一边却转过身来说：'哦，但是我们并不期望男性在家中接替女性的角色。'

advancement.sentenceEn: It symbolizes India's advancement in high-tech.
advancement.translationZh: 它象征着印度在高科技领域的进步。

advertise.sentenceEn: Big houses are advertised as a reward for hard work and diligence, turning housing from a basic necessity into a luxury.
advertise.translationZh: 大房子被宣传为辛勤工作的回报，这将住房从基本必需品转变为了奢侈品。
advertise.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

advertise.sentenceEn: This research finds that one way to promote a healthy diet could be to advertise the social benefits of healthy choices.
advertise.translationZh: 这项研究发现，推广健康饮食的一种方法可能是宣传健康选择所带来的社交益处。

authentic.sentenceEn: As I describe in my book, The Authentic Heart, it is the courage to be authentic that connects us in a deeper way.

authentic.sentenceEn: And it turns out that when they write for strangers, their sense of " authentic audience" makes them work harder, push themselves further, and create powerful new communicative forms.
